name: Canonical Tupper Constant
message:
You found the number that draws its own formula. 🪄

That's the trick of this whole site: paste the right integer, and something that looks like noise turns out to hold a picture — or, sometimes, a note like this one.

Somewhere in this app is another number. Riley picked it on purpose.

name: Riley's Confession (edit me)
message:
Hi. If you're reading this, you pasted the number I gave you into RileysCrush — so first: thank you for actually trying it. 💜

I drew a little heart, one pixel at a time, and this absurdly long integer is what it turns into when you run it through Tupper's formula. It's silly and it's math-nerd overkill, but I wanted to say something true in a way you couldn't Google.

I like you. I've liked you for a while now, and I wasn't sure how to say it without it feeling like *just* another message — so I built you a whole number instead.

No pressure at all. But if you want to talk about it, you know where to find me.

— Riley
